meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据同步到云端账号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望在不同设备间同步Claude记忆数据
copy.tagline_en: Sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to sync Claude memories across devices

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以检查记忆云同步状态，或首次设置同步到 cmem.ai Pro 账户。它会报告待同步条目数、上次刷新时间和错误信息。
howto.when: 当用户提到“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”、“云备份”、“同步状态”等关键词，或要求备份/同步记忆数据库时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查记忆云同步状态。
say.note: Claude 会查询同步状态并报告待同步条目数。

say.text: 设置云同步到 cmem.ai Pro。
say.note: Claude 会引导输入令牌和用户 ID 完成首次配置。

say.text: 迁移旧的独立同步客户端。
say.note: 如果检测到旧客户端，Claude 会自动迁移并停用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check cloud sync status or set up first-time sync to cmem.ai Pro. It reports pending counts, last flush time, and errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or asks to backup/sync their memory database.

say_en.text: Check my memory cloud sync status.
say_en.note: Claude queries sync status and reports pending items.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync to cmem.ai Pro.
say_en.note: Claude guides to enter token and user ID for first-time setup.

say_en.text: Migrate the old standalone sync client.
say_en.note: If detected, Claude migrates and retires the legacy client.
